scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "cross-env HARBOR_PLAYER_DEV=1 node --watch dist/server/index.js --no-open" "vite --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.desktop.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --project=chrome && playwright test --project=edge
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.beta.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.beta.yml --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.beta.yml --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.test:desktop:smoke:portable: npm run fixtures && cross-env HARBOR_PLAYER_SMOKE_EXPECT_PORTABLE=1 node scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests *.ts package.json tsconfig*.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests *.ts package.json tsconfig*.json eslint.config.js
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && playwright test --grep "Tab cycles only through text entry fields|fullscreen button changes the application shell"
